faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Do you have questions about security or how the platform works? Find the answers here.
faq.q1: Is it safe to share my children's location in the app?
faq.a1: Rumbo uses end-to-end SSL encryption. Location information is private and accessible only to the registered parent and authorized driver.
faq.q2: What happens if the school vehicle loses internet access?
faq.a2: The system immediately alerts the school dispatcher and parent when the GPS signal is interrupted for more than 3 minutes, activating an emergency reporting protocol.
faq.q3: Can the driver use the app while driving?
faq.a3: Absolutely not. The driver's application is designed for minimal interaction, with voice commands and large one-touch controls that are only used during authorized stops.
